newsitem.title: USA: Two typhoons threaten shipping off southern Japan.
newsitem.headline: Two typhoons threaten shipping off southern Japan.

text.p: Two typhoons are a threat to shipping off the southern islands of Japan, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.
Typhoon Zane, with top winds near 100 mph, is just north of Okinawa and moving east at 9 mph. Zane will weaken over the next two days while it moves into the waters southeast of Japan.
Typhon Yates also has top winds of nearly 100 mph and is centred about 120 miles northwest of Chichijima. It is moving north northeast at 20 mph.
Yates will steadily weaken during the next 36 to 48 hours, but will remain a threat to shipping.
